Welcome to WOS!

Let's take a quick tour of the Integrated Learning Environment. This 5-minute walkthrough will introduce you to the key features.

Terminal Basics

This is the WOS terminal. Try typing ls and pressing Enter to see the directory contents.

The terminal prompt shows your current directory. You can run commands just like a real Unix shell.

Visual System Monitor

The Visual Monitor shows real-time process information. Try typing ps to see the process list.

You'll see process IDs (PIDs), states, and parent-child relationships. This helps you understand how processes work.

Time-Travel Debugger

The Time-Travel Debugger lets you step through system call history. Try dragging the timeline slider to explore past states.

Watch how processes are created and destroyed. You can jump to any point in history to inspect the system state.

Learning Objectives & Tests

The Learning Objectives panel shows your progress through the curriculum. Click "Run Tests" to see red/green feedback.

Progressive hints provide scaffolded support when you need help. Tests turn green when your implementation is correct.

Great job! You're ready to start building.

Need help? Click the ? icon anytime to access documentation and retake this tutorial.

Remember: Learning to build an operating system takes time. Use the progressive hints, run tests frequently, and explore at your own pace.
